title: Mostly just happy I got to see a full show at Arena Stage this time #...
transcript: I didn't think I was going to make it to wrinkle in time but I managed to tack this one onto my Beyonce trip and it was worth it a wrinkle in time is a new musical adaptation of the novel of the same name this musical is adapted by Heather Christian doing the music and Lauren Yee doing the book I was very intrigued about this I went to a presentation of some of the songs a over a year ago now while this musical has made a lot of progress from that last presentation that I saw and I still think it has a lot of potential this adaptation needs a lot of work I really really enjoyed this cast especially the principal cast but I also have to shout out Jayke Workman who is a member of the ensemble and they were just such a stand out for me I really I've always loved their work but especially in this I also for the most part really enjoyed the score I like Heather Christian's music and if they ever record this I would listen to these songs but I've only seen one other Heather Christian show and what I understand from the shows that she usually writes on her own they're very vibes based and this score definitely felt like a lot of you know vibes and I don't know if that works for a show with a traditional plot structure because while I enjoyed listening to the songs for the most part they didn't move the plot forward and I needed that from a wrinkle in time and there were definitely exceptions where I was getting forward momentum in the show for the most part really enjoyed the book by Lauren Yee I just feel like right now in both the writing and especially the the direction that this musical doesn't know whether it wants to be theatre for young audiences or a theatre for a wider audience that is also okay for children think like Lion King Lion King is a show for families of all ages but it doesn't ever feel like it's geared for just children like adults would enjoy it there's something very artistic about Lion King Lion King really balances the fact that it's for families but also can be appreciated by adults who go see a lot of theatre a wrinkle in time right now has aspects that feel like it's for all audiences but then so much of it is directed like it is geared just for children and I will say credit where credit is due there were a lot of really young kids in that audience when I went to go see it cause I went on a Saturday matinee and they were entranced like they were absolutely hooked into that story I on the other hand was struggling to stay awake this entire show and granted I was very sleep deprived I saw Beyonce the night before and I had just flown in but there have been shows where I've seen incredibly sleep deprived that like kept me wide awake the entire time and this just wasn't one of those but I think it could be I also think that a wrinkle in time is a brilliant piece of science fiction literature that has great world building and also a really great message at the heart of it that is what you think are your biggest flaws could be your biggest strengths and what you think are your biggest strengths could be your biggest flaws and I wish that the story that they told in this musical leaned more heavily on that concept it's there it's present because it's such a vital part of the show I just wish it was set up a little better throughout the show and I also wish the world building was a little bit stronger I you you can kind of sense it but I wish that the sound of each of these planets but mostly visually each of these planets was more distinct I just feel like the direction and the design of this musical could have been more visually interesting and it wasn't there yet for me I also just feel like there's no reason especially if the show is geared towards younger audiences that it needs to be two and a half hours but I feel like you could justify that time by having there be more forward momentum in the show and have it be a little less vibes based with that being said the cast absolutely incredible and I would listen to the score outside of the context of the show I still feel like however that there's a lot of potential with this musical I feel like if they can strengthen the writing and really it down to the story that they wanna tell I feel like if the direction and the design can be more visually interesting and if the lyrics can move the momentum forward as opposed to just living in this at the real state for each of the songs that this is going to be a strong adaptation it's just it's not there yet for me but at the end of the day I'm glad I made this trip to see the progress that it has made I am sure we have not seen the last of this adaptation and I hope that they continue to still work on it if you are in the dC area as far as tickets go this does close on Sunday on July 20th I got my tickets through today tix I got 10% off because I'm a gold member they did have a 15 dollar front row lottery but you have to enter that a week in advance so that is done for the run they also had a pay what your age is scheme if you're under the age of 35 so there's a lot of discount options available at Arena Stage I think most of those are gone for this production but you still can see this for one more week
classificationReason: Creator reviews 'A Wrinkle in Time' musical at Arena Stage, but this show is not on the provided list
